scope: Local development evaluation on the 39-bucket Delphi 3e18 one-phase/two-phase paired fit swarms and the exposed append-only 3e18 development archive.

data_use.untouched_confirmation: none; every heldout result in this batch is development evidence

decomposition.aggregate_response: SFOS39 fitted only to independently trained one-phase rows
decomposition.phase_response: two-phase minus aggregate-matched one-phase BPB fitted only to the exact 280 paired policies
decomposition.phase_fraction_source: c0 / (c0 + c1), checked constant across buckets
decomposition.tied_requirement: Every chronological feature is exactly zero when phase_0_weight equals phase_1_weight.

candidate_batch.mechanism: No chronological effect; aggregate response only.
Bounded occupancy abandonment and late novelty relative to the aggregate-matched tied trajectory.
One signed secant and one Jensen coefficient for the complete fitted aggregate potential.
Family-specific signed secant and Jensen coefficients for the complete fitted aggregate potential.
Family-specific signed secant and Jensen coefficients for diminishing-benefit shortage potential only.
Family-specific shortage and replay secant/Jensen channels, preserving their distinct mechanisms.

phase_fit.selection: Nested inner CV within every outer fold; final ridge selected by full-fit CV.

heldout_slices: exact aggregate fibers with observed tied controls

development_gate.fit_delta: Improve mean paired-delta OOF RMSE by at least 5% on one target versus HAN39 and worsen the other by no more than 5%.
development_gate.heldout: Improve a primary heldout diagnostic materially on one target without more than 3% target-matched RMSE regression on the other.
development_gate.regret: Do not worsen policy-matched heldout Regret@1 by more than 0.002 BPB.
development_gate.optimism: Do not increase the count of target-matched optimism errors above 0.05 BPB on either target.
development_gate.calibration: Move observed-on-predicted calibration toward one on at least one target without moving materially away on the other.
development_gate.complexity: Any retained mechanism must survive its nested restriction and have stable coefficient signs across outer folds.
development_gate.optimization: A promoted model must have a plausible and bootstrap-stable raw optimum; deployment regularization cannot satisfy this gate.
